import requests, numpy as np, json, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def fetch(p): return requests.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text
def parse(t,ch='A'):
    o=[]
    for l in t.split('\n'):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and len(l)>54 and l[21]==ch and l[16] in (' ','A'):
            try: n=int(l[22:26])
            except: continue
            o.append((l[:6].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),n,l[12:16].strip(),np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
    return o
def CAs(a,lo=None,hi=None): return [(n,AA3[r],*x) for rec,r,n,nm,x in a if nm=='CA' and r in AA3 and (lo is None or n>=lo) and (hi is None or n<=hi)]
def kab(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);M=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(M)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def ap(R,t,X): return (R@np.asarray(X,float).T).T+t
def nw(S,g=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; Hl=[[0.0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; Pl=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    for i in range(1,n+1): Hl[i][0]=Hl[i-1][0]+g; Pl[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Hl[0][j]=Hl[0][j-1]+g; Pl[0][j]=2
    Sl=S.tolist()
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        hi=Hl[i];hp=Hl[i-1];si=Sl[i-1];pi=Pl[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=hp[j-1]+si[j-1];b=hp[j]+g;c=hi[j-1]+g
            if a>=b and a>=c: hi[j]=a
            elif b>=c: hi[j]=b;pi[j]=1
            else: hi[j]=c;pi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=Pl[i][j]
        if i>0 and j>0 and p==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif i>0 and p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmref(X,Y,pairs,Ln):
    d0=max(1.24*(Ln-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5); idx=np.array(pairs); best=0;bRt=None;cb=[]
    for Li in [len(idx),max(4,len(idx)//2),max(4,len(idx)//4),max(4,len(idx)//8)]:
        for st in range(0,len(idx)-Li+1,max(1,Li)): cb.append((Li,st))
    for Li,st in cb[:24]:
        sub=idx[st:st+Li]
        for it in range(20):
            if len(sub)<4: break
            R,t=kab(X[sub[:,0]],Y[sub[:,1]]); Xt=ap(R,t,X)
            d=np.linalg.norm(Xt[idx[:,0]]-Y[idx[:,1]],axis=1)
            s=float((1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/Ln)
            if s>best: best=s;bRt=(R,t)
            dc=max(d0,3.0);new=idx[d<dc]
            while len(new)<4 and dc<12: dc+=.5;new=idx[d<dc]
            if len(new)==len(sub) and np.array_equal(new,sub): break
            sub=new
    return best,bRt
def tmalign(c1,c2,ns=20,ni=5):
    X=np.array([c[2:] for c in c1],float);Y=np.array([c[2:] for c in c2],float)
    n,m=len(X),len(Y);Lm=min(n,m);d0=max(1.24*(Lm-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5);sd=[]
    for fr in [1.,.5,.3]:
        l=max(8,int(Lm*fr));st=max(1,l//2)
        for i in range(0,n-l+1,st):
            for j in range(0,m-l+1,st): sd.append([(i+k,j+k) for k in range(l)])
    bt=0;bp=None
    for s in sd[:ns]:
        pr=s
        for it in range(ni):
            idx=np.array(pr)
            if len(idx)<4: break
            R,t=kab(X[idx[:,0]],Y[idx[:,1]]);Xt=ap(R,t,X)
            D=np.linalg.norm(Xt[:,None,:]-Y[None,:,:],axis=2);pr=nw(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
        if pr and len(pr)>=4:
            tm,_=tmref(X,Y,pr,Lm)
            if tm>bt: bt=tm;bp=pr
    tm,Rt=tmref(X,Y,bp,Lm); return tm,Rt,bp
af=requests.get(requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q6FWH9',headers=H,timeout=60).json()[0]['pdbUrl'],headers=H,timeout=120).text
A6=[a for a in parse(af,'A')]; A6ca=CAs(A6,100,411)
REFS=[('1V8E',None,None,'GDPD\nT. thermophilus'),('1DJX',290,620,'PLC-$\\delta$1 barrel\nrat (+Ca$^{2+}$)'),
      ('1PTD',None,None,'PI-PLC\nB. cereus'),('1YDY',None,None,'GlpQ GDPD\nE. coli'),
      ('1TIM',None,None,'TIM\n(control)'),('7BX0',None,None,'Rtt109 HAT\nC. albicans')]
tms={}
for pid,lo,hi,lab in REFS:
    ref=CAs(parse(fetch(pid),'A'),lo,hi); tm,Rt,bp=tmalign(A6ca,ref); tms[pid]=(tm,lab)
    print(pid,round(tm,3))
# Ca mapping for 1DJX
REF=parse(fetch('1DJX'),'A'); tm,(R,t),bp=tmalign(A6ca,CAs(REF,290,620))
CApos=[x for rec,r,n,nm,x in REF if rec=='HETATM' and r=='CA' and n==2][0]
A6t=[(AA3[r],n,nm,ap(R,t,x[None,:])[0]) for rec,r,n,nm,x in A6 if r in AA3]
want={126:'NE2',127:'OD1',147:'OE1',149:'OD1',176:'ND1',232:'OD2',234:'NZ',129:'OH',372:'NH1'}
refw={311:'NE2',312:'OD1',341:'OE2',343:'OD1',356:'NE2',390:'OE1',314:'OH',549:'NH1'}
dq={}; dr={}
for r_,n,nm,x in A6t:
    if n in want and nm==want[n]: dq[f'{r_}{n}']=float(np.linalg.norm(x-CApos))
for rec,r_,n,nm,x in REF:
    if r_ in AA3 and n in refw and nm==refw[n]: dr[f'{AA3[r_]}{n}']=float(np.linalg.norm(x-CApos))
print(dq); print(dr)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,1)
order=sorted(tms.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1][0])
ax.barh([v[1] for k,v in order],[v[0] for k,v in order],
        color=['#1f7a4d' if v[0]>0.45 else '#7f8c8d' for k,v in order])
ax.axvline(0.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(0.505,-0.4,'TM 0.5: same fold',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('TM-score (normalised by the shorter chain)')
ax.set_title('A  AIM6 (Q6FWH9, res 100-411) against characterised folds')
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,2)
names=['H126\n(H311)','N127\n(N312)','Y129\n(Y314)','E147\n(E341)','D149\n(D343)','H176\n(H356)','D232\n(E390)','K234\n(-)','R372\n(R549)']
vq=[dq.get(k,np.nan) for k in ['H126','N127','Y129','E147','D149','H176','D232','K234','R372']]
vr=[dr.get(k,np.nan) for k in ['H311','N312','Y314','E341','D343','H356','E390',None,'R549']]
x=np.arange(len(names))
ax.bar(x-0.2,vq,0.4,label='AIM6 model (superposed)',color='#2e86c1')
ax.bar(x+0.2,vr,0.4,label='PLC-$\\delta$1 crystal 1DJX',color='#c0392b')
ax.axhline(2.6,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(0.1,2.75,'direct Ca$^{2+}$ coordination',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel('distance to catalytic Ca$^{2+}$ site ($\\AA$)')
ax.set_title('B  AIM6 side chains reach the PLC-$\\delta$1 catalytic metal site'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,3)
cons=dict(zip([124,126,127,129,147,149,176,232,234,279,308,326,372,374],
              [81.2,85.7,83.0,83.6,82.9,86.2,79.5,85.7,84.7,80.3,50.5,60.5,88.9,94.0]))
lbl=['H124','H126','N127','Y129','E147','D149','H176','D232','K234','T279','D308','S326','R372','W374']
ax.bar(range(len(cons)),list(cons.values()),color='#2e86c1')
ax.axhline(34.4,ls='--',c='k',lw=1,label='domain background mean (34.4%)')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(lbl))); ax.set_xticklabels(lbl,rotation=60,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('% identical across 120 fungal genera')
ax.set_title('C  Conservation of the site in the AIM6 family (permutation p = 2x10$^{-4}$)'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,4)
pk=pd.DataFrame([('AIM6 model',111,-6.31),('PLC-$\\delta$1 1DJX',265,-4.71),('GDPD 2PZ0',52,-11.28),
                 ('GlpQ 1YDY',577,-1.68),('TIM 1TIM (control)',149,-1.78)],columns=['s','vol','phi'])
ax.scatter(pk.vol,pk.phi,s=90,c=['#c0392b' if s=='AIM6 model' else '#2e86c1' for s in pk.s])
for _,r in pk.iterrows(): ax.annotate(r.s,(r.vol,r.phi),fontsize=8,xytext=(5,5),textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_xlabel('enclosed cavity volume at the site ($\\AA^3$)'); ax.set_ylabel('Coulomb potential at cavity centre (kcal/mol/e)')
ax.set_title('D  The AIM6 barrel-axis cavity is enclosed and electronegative')
